_comment: Known race starting-grid penalties. 'places' drops a driver from each predicted/simulated qualifying result; 'back_of_grid' fixes them behind the field. Qualifying fantasy points remain based on the unpenalized qualifying result.

12._note: Belgian GP confirmed penalties before FP3: HAD starts at the back; NOR and STR receive 10-place drops.

13._note: Hungarian GP confirmed post-qualifying penalties: HAM and ANT receive three-place grid drops.

15._note: Italian GP confirmed pre-qualifying penalties: ANT and ALB start from the back of the grid regardless of qualifying position.

18._note: Updated 2026-10-02 for Bahrain GP in Malaysia power-unit changes: Colapinto receives 15 places total (five from the Baku restart collision plus ten for a new engine); Hadjar receives five places; Lindblad receives 30 places and starts at the back of the grid. Sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/colapinto-hit-with-five-place-grid-penalty-for-bahrain-gp-in-malaysia-after-baku-collision.3gWVfzDMMr5hReiwTt1fPD ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-17/ ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-18/ ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-19/

20._note: United States GP post-FP1: penalties supplied by the user on 2026-10-23. Bortoleto starts at the back of the grid; Colapinto drops 10 places; Lindblad drops five places. Qualifying points use the unpenalised classification.

21._note: FIA Doc 60 (2026-11-01): VER +1, LAW +1 and qualifying DSQ, BOT 50 places/back. Bortoleto P13 has no grid drop on the published grid; this supersedes the earlier user-reported five-place assumption. Exact post-quali starts are stored in post_quali_results.json.

22._note: FIA final qualifying classification Doc 50 and provisional starting grid Doc 51, published 7 November. Banked qualifying points from the official Fantasy feed. Hamilton starts P20 after a 75-place/back-of-grid penalty; Verstappen P21 and Perez P22. Exact published starts are stored in post_quali_results.json.

23._note: Las Vegas GP, 2026-11-20. FIA stewards' decisions 16–20 confirm Piastri (ICE), Antonelli (ICE), Sainz (turbocharger), Stroll (energy store and control electronics), and Bearman (ICE, turbocharger, exhaust, and MGU-K). Bearman's 35-place penalty puts him at the back under Article B2.5.4b.iv. Source: https://www.fia.com/documents/championships/fia-formula-one-world-championship-14/season/season-2026-2072/event/Las%20Vegas%20Grand%20Prix

24._note: FIA Las Vegas Doc 61, 21 November 2026. Sergio Pérez drops five grid places at his next race after the collision with Rafael Câmara. Source: https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_las_vegas_grand_prix_-_infringement_-_car_11_-_causing_a_collision_with_car_51.pdf
